courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 液態調諧阻尼器
related.transfer: 可遷移「風致振動與居住舒適度」與「環境振動量測與系統識別」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；液態調諧阻尼器的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" and "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tuned liquid dampers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內；液態調諧阻尼器則以以水槽晃動頻率、有效水量與水頭損失阻尼，把高樓風致加速度降到舒適度門檻內為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits; Tuned liquid dampers centres on sloshing frequency, effective water mass and head-loss damping that bring tall-building wind acceleration within comfort limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「頂層樓板加速度」與「屋頂水槽群」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到液態調諧阻尼器，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「福祿數相似律與模型試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Top-floor acceleration” and “Rooftop tank array”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tuned liquid dampers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Froude similitude and model testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「風致振動與居住舒適度」與「環境振動量測與系統識別」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wind-induced motion and occupant comfort" and "Ambient vibration measurement and system identification" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Viscous-damper performance verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以質量比、調頻與阻尼最佳化，把超高層風振加速度降到舒適度門檻內；黏滯阻尼器性能驗證則以以力—速度本構、原型與逐件試驗、安裝置中與系統識別，證明每具黏滯阻尼器提供設計阻尼為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on mass ratio, tuning and damping optimisation that bring supertall wind-induced acceleration below comfort limits; Viscous-damper performance verification centres on force–velocity laws, prototype and production tests, installation centring and system identification that prove every viscous damper delivers its design damping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「頂層樓板加速度」與「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到黏滯阻尼器性能驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Top-floor acceleration” and “Supplemental damping ratio”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Viscous-damper performance verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器
history.titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
history.text: Hermann Frahm 於 1909 年提出以附加質量抑制振動的構想並取得專利，Ormondroyd 與 Den Hartog 在 1928 年建立阻尼吸振器理論，Den Hartog 的教科書使最佳調頻與阻尼公式成為工程常識。1970 年代末紐約花旗集團中心與波士頓約翰漢考克大樓率先在高樓裝設調諧質量阻尼器；2004 年完工的台北 101 把巨大鋼球擺錘公開展示，2010 年代的上海中心大廈則採用以磁鐵與銅板產生阻尼的渦電流擺錘。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Hermann Frahm proposed damping vibration with an added mass and patented the idea from 1909, Ormondroyd and Den Hartog developed damped vibration-absorber theory in 1928, and Den Hartog's textbook made the optimum tuning and damping formulas engineering common knowledge. In the late 1970s Citicorp Center in New York and the John Hancock Tower in Boston were early tall buildings with tuned mass dampers; Taipei 101, completed in 2004, put its giant steel-sphere pendulum on public display, and Shanghai Tower in the 2010s used a pendulum damped by magnets moving over copper plates. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
